revised_statement: For every finite group G, the untwisted flat-connection count on the canonical 4D 1-5, 2-4 and 3-3 Pachner pairs, divided by |G| to the number of interior vertices, agrees for every fixed flat common boundary. The normalized total counts also agree for every finite compatible exterior family represented by dependent pairs, with the same outside-vertex count.
boundary: The supplied finite group, untwisted flat-connection model, canonical local complexes and compatible finite exterior interface are explicit. No general triangulation/gluing-equivalence or PL-homeomorphism library is formalized; no Regge, twisted/Crane-Yetter, fermion-sign or continuum conclusion follows. Human review remains pending.
